data.name: Bookkeeper
data.description: Read-only access to financial data such as orders, transactions and billing data. Cannot modify products, customers, or settings.

data.name: Content/Product Manager
data.description: Manages products and plans, its pricing. Cannot access financials, customer data, user management, or system settings.

data.name: Customer Service
data.description: Views and assists customers, manages support requests, returns, and order issues. Cannot change product and plans, financials, or system settings.

data.name: Read-only
data.description: View-only access to key business data. Cannot create, edit, or delete anything.

data.name: Sales
data.description: Originates customer purchases and subscriptions. Limited access to product and plans; no access to system settings.

data.name: Workspace Admin
data.description: Manages users and settings, has limited view access and empowered for specific operations (delete). Cannot perform business operations.
